environment: The workspace is this git repository only (PavelRPavlov/Kroiko). Every agent and sub-agent works inside the repository root; nothing outside it is part of the task.
hard_deny: Reading, listing, searching, creating, modifying or deleting files or directories outside the repository root (parent folders, sibling projects, the home directory, other git repositories, system folders), with a shell command or any other tool. Build tooling such as dotnet restore/build/test and Playwright may use their own package and browser caches implicitly.
Changing user-level or machine-level configuration outside the repository: ~/.gitconfig, ~/.claude, ~/.nuget/NuGet.Config, shell profiles, global dotnet tools, or system settings.
